_meta.session: Session 72 — Anthropic Fable/Mythos 5 PDF final unmined-sections deep re-mine
_meta.notes: Final-pass deep re-mine. Found 7+ NEW SOTAs that were unmined: SWE-bench Verified Mythos 5 95.5 NEW (was Fable 5 95.0, +0.5pp). SWE-bench Multilingual Mythos 5 92.2 NEW (was Mythos Preview 87.3, +4.9pp). SWE-bench Multimodal Mythos 5 54.9 (was 59.0 — WAIT, this is LOWER. Different metric? Or PDF says Mythos 5 'internal harness' 54.9 vs official 59.0). DRACO Mythos 5 86.4 NEW (was Opus 4.8 80.4). ChartMuseum Mythos 5 93.2 (NEW bench). LAB-Bench FigQA Mythos 5 90.7 (NEW bench). Multi-Agent BrowseComp async-subagents 93.3 (NEW bench, async harness Pareto-dominates single-agent). BenchCAD 1000-file subset Mythos 5 0.650 w/tools NEW bench. ProgramBench Mythos 5 range 84-93% NEW SOTA (was Opus 4.8 88, our mid-range).
